name: zipcode-news-source-registry
description: Community-vetted local data sources, plus a reference toolkit for querying, cleaning and diagnosing them. Not published to npm — copy what you need.

scripts.//test: Bare --test auto-discovers test/**/*.test.mjs. `node --test test/` fails on Node 26, which resolves the directory as a module entry point.

//: No dependencies, and none are wanted: this code is meant to be READ and COPIED into a publisher's own repo (see TOOLKIT.md), not installed. A dependency here would become an unaudited dependency in someone else's publishing pipeline.
